item.title: NBR to cut tax on mobile making, imports to lower prices

item.title: JP (Quader) joins polls race
item.description: The Jatiya Party (Quader faction) has formally launched its nomination process for the 13th National Parliament election, announcing a detailed schedule for the distribution of nomination forms and interviews of aspirant candidates, following directives from party chairman Golam Mohammad Quader.According to an official notice circulated on Monday, the distribution of nomination forms will begin on Wednesday, December 17, and continue until Sunday, December 21, 2025. item.title: DB takes over Hadi shooting probe
item.description: The Detective Branch (DB) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has been tasked with investigating the attempted killing of Inquilab Mancha Convenor Sharif Osman Hadi.A case over the shooting in Dhaka's Bijoynagar was filed at Paltan Police Station on Sunday. item.title: Trump sues BBC for defamation over Panorama speech edit
item.description: US President Donald Trump has filed a multi-billion-dollar defamation lawsuit against the BBC over an edit of his 6 January 2021 speech in a Panorama documentary.Trump accused the broadcaster of defamation and of violating a trade practices law, according to court documents filed in Florida. item.title: Nation celebrating Victory Day

item.title: Enemies of independence want to rise again: Fakhrul
item.description: Those who took a stand against independence in 1971, want to rise again, said BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on Tuesday.
